    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "User"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IRI_EXPR
          IDENT "ex"
          SHAPE_SEP ":"
          IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"

        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "users"

        PROPERTY_LHS
          KW_IRI "iri"

        EXPR

            IDENT "id"

          IDENT "name"
